renderedTexts: 韧性；适应力；从困境中恢复的能力
The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties or adversity.
Her resilience helped her rebuild her life after the flood.
她的韧性帮助她在洪水之后重建了生活。
The ability of a material to spring back into shape after being bent or compressed.
The rubber's resilience makes it ideal for shock absorbers.
橡胶的回弹性使其非常适合用作减震器。
